On the unmirrored full-resolution native, Vientos is RHB and the front of his Mets jersey (#27) is facing the camera. The low lateral camera is on the first-base side of home plate, consistent with the batter’s chest-facing orientation; the catcher is offset farther across the plate. The exact side assignment follows this body/plate geometry, not the catcher offset or face orientation alone. The view remains lateral base-side, not center-field/pitcher-axis.
